push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 5.8 against pilot grape. Rough one. Let's talk about it like grown-ups and then let it go.

- Rating came in 0.9 below what your on-ball stats earned. Try this: Goal-side and central first, ball-side second. Cover the space behind the full-back when they press. You've got this.
- on-ball involvement needs work from you and buddskees. Easy plan: make triangles, 1-2 touch.
- 1.6 under average. You'll be back above it soon enough.

Before next match: Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.

tuxedo_slide, write this on your hand if you have to: The ball doesn't know your rating. Neither should your attitude.

I'm in your corner, always. - Coach Lasso
